sloka: ः ।विमोचयित्वा तं बन्धं प्रकृतिस्थः स्थितः पुनः ।आयसं परिघं गृह्य तानि रक्षांस्यसूदयम् ।ततस्तन्नगरद्वारं वेगेनाप्लुतवानहम् ।। ५.५८.१५४ ।।।।
transliteration: ḥ ।vimocayitvā taṁ bandhaṁ prakṛtisthaḥ sthitaḥ punaḥ ।āyasaṁ parighaṁ gṛhya tāni rakṣāṁsyasūdayam ।tatastannagaradvāraṁ vegenāplutavānaham ।। 5.58.154 ।।।।

translations.english: "I reduced my form and rid of the bondage. Then again I assumed my original huge form and took up an iron bar lying near and killed all the demons (present).
